title: Security Incident: Developer Wallet Compromised
summary: On 12 Oct 2026 a ZUBA developer wallet was hacked and ownership of the $ZUBA contract was changed. Here is what happened, the on-chain evidence, and what we are doing about it.
achievements: Confirmed the hack and traced the ownership transfer on-chain (block 127133369)
Secured the team's remaining wallets and devices
Started tracing the attacker's wallets and reporting the addresses
next: Share the full recovery plan with the community
Publish findings on the PinkSale lock interaction
Keep holders updated here, on X and on Telegram
body:
Family, I need to speak to you plainly today.

On **Monday, 12 October 2026**, one of our developer wallets was compromised, and through it the **ownership of the $ZUBA smart contract was changed without our permission**. I am telling you this directly and openly because you deserve the truth from us first, not from rumours.

This is a challenging time, but it **calls for no panic**. We are on it, every hour, and we will come out of this together.

## What happened

Everything below is public on BNB Smart Chain and anyone can verify it on BscScan. Our official contract is still **0xE1bf97baCF682AE17cA3E239aB68a7b525f994A4**.

**1. Ownership of the contract was transferred.**
At **02:44:47 AM UTC on 12 October 2026** (block **127133369**), the developer wallet **0x5ee9926564cB98ab3EBc256bCadDD1372cb7f53f** called the **Transfer Ownership** function on the $ZUBA contract. The transaction succeeded. That wallet was in the hands of the attacker at that point.

Transaction hash: `0x4e971e7bffd0881234e4ff114456aa9ab693e1806d33545a4650b31b9dcedec8`

![BscScan: Transfer Ownership called on the $ZUBA contract](/media/incident/ownership-transfer.jpg)

**2. Many more attempts followed.**
Over the next hours, the same wallet sent a series of **Transfer Ownership**, **Renounce Ownership**, **Transfer** and **Transfer From** calls to the contract. Many of these failed, as you can see from the red markers in the transaction list, which shows someone trying different moves on the contract.

![BscScan: transaction history on the $ZUBA contract](/media/incident/transactions.jpg)

**3. The same wallet interacted with PinkSale's lock contract.**
The compromised wallet also sent a transaction to **PinkSale: PinkLock V2** (**0x407993575c91ce7643a4d4cCACc9A98c36eE1BBE**), the contract used to lock tokens and liquidity. We are reviewing exactly what that call did and will share our findings.

![BscScan: interaction with PinkSale PinkLock V2](/media/incident/pinklock-interaction.jpg)

**4. The new controller changed the trading taxes.**
After ownership moved, the wallet **0xeD86643D…aD4c9442F** called **Set Buy Tax** and **Set Sell Tax** on the contract. The contract owner has powers such as setting taxes and blacklisting or whitelisting wallets, so in the wrong hands these settings can be used against holders.

![BscScan: owner functions on the $ZUBA contract, including blacklist, whitelist and transferOwnership](/media/incident/contract-functions.jpg)

## What this means for you right now

- **Be careful trading $ZUBA until we post our next update.** The buy and sell taxes were changed by the party now controlling the contract, so a trade could cost far more than you expect.
- **Nobody from ZUBA will ever DM you first** or ask for your seed phrase, private key or a "recovery fee". Anyone offering to "recover" your tokens is a scammer. Ignore and report them.
- **Only trust updates posted here on the Dev Notes, on our X @zubatoken, and in our Telegram t.me/zubatokenchat.**

## What we are doing

- We have **secured our remaining wallets** and are reviewing every key and device connected to the team.
- We are **tracing the attacker on-chain**, following every wallet and transaction linked to this hack. Everything on the blockchain leaves a trail, and we are following it.
- We are working with our security partners and reaching out to the platforms and services involved to report the addresses.
- We are preparing a **recovery plan** for the ZUBA community. Our next line of action will be communicated here very soon.

## Our promise

ZUBA is bigger than one wallet and bigger than one bad night. The games, the animation, the story, the partners and this community are still here, and so am I.

Our goal is clear: **we will do everything in our power so that no holder carries the weight of this alone, and that every one of us feels as little of the impact as possible.** The solution we are bringing will be shared in our next update.

Stay calm, stay together, and stay alert. We will recover from this, and we will come back stronger.

**Dev. Vicky**
Founder, ZUBA Token

title: The World Gets a Voice: Music, Partnerships and More
summary: A living hero with ZUBA in motion, our own licensed soundtrack, the Partner With Us page, share buttons, Dev Notes by email, 14 listings and new allies.
achievements: New home hero with ZUBA in motion and a night-violet colour grade
Our own licensed soundtrack, The Call of ZUBA, now plays across the site
Partner With Us page with six paths and smart application forms
Share buttons with rich previews on every blog post and dev note
Dev Notes by email with a welcome scroll and one-click unsubscribe
14 listing platforms and 14 partners shown with real logos
Home page Questions section and new Telegram: t.me/zubatokenchat
Google Search Console verified, sitemap and rich previews for search
next: Review the first partner and tester applications
Open the first tester round for the ZUBA game
Share new animation work from the ZUBA story
body:
Family, today was a big building day for ZUBA. I spent the whole Sunday on the website because this is our home on the internet, and I want every holder, partner and new visitor to feel the ZUBA spirit the moment they land on it. Here is everything that changed and why it matters.

## 1. A brand new hero with ZUBA in motion

The first thing you see on the home page is now a living scene. ZUBA stands in his royal robe with his moon staff while the world moves behind him, with a night-violet colour grade that matches our identity. I cleaned the hero up so it is simple and straight to the point: who we are, our contract address with one-tap copy, and two doors, the Whitepaper and the Theatre. Less noise, more feeling.

**Why it matters:** first impressions decide if someone stays. Now the first three seconds tell them we are building a real animated universe, not just a ticker.

## 2. Our own music: "The Call of ZUBA"

The website now has its own soundtrack. "The Call of ZUBA" is music made for ZUBA and fully licensed to us, so this is our sound, used with every right in place. It fades in smoothly as you start exploring, and it keeps playing as you move from page to page, so the whole visit feels like one journey through the ZUBA world.

**Why it matters:** games and anime live on sound. When you hear that theme again in our trailers and games, you will know where you heard it first.

## 3. Partner With Us is now open

There is now a full **Partner With Us** page in the menu. We have six paths, and the application form changes based on the path you pick:

- **Anime & Movies:** studios and creators who want to co-produce African anime, films and series with us.
- **Games:** game projects who want crossovers, $ZUBA utility in their games or joint launches.
- **Marketing:** agencies, KOLs, communities and listing platforms who can carry our story further.
- **Testers:** gamers who want to play our games before anyone else, report bugs and get rewarded in $ZUBA.
- **Creators:** artists, streamers, writers and meme makers who want to tell ZUBA stories and get rewarded.
- **Developers & Animators:** talents who want to join the ZUBA team. Game developers, 2D and 3D animators, illustrators, writers, sound and Web3 devs, your seat is ready.

Every application comes straight to my inbox and our team dashboard, so nobody falls through the cracks. If you prefer to talk directly, the page also has a button to reach me on Telegram.

**Why it matters:** ZUBA is bigger than one team. The fastest way to build an African universe is to build it with the best people across Africa and the world.

## 4. Share our stories everywhere

Every blog post and every dev note (including this one) now has a **Share** bar. You can share with your phone's share menu, copy the link, or send it straight to X, Telegram or WhatsApp. When you paste the link anywhere, it now shows a proper preview card with the image, title and summary.

**Why it matters:** our community is our marketing. Every share now looks clean and professional and brings people straight to the right page.

## 5. Dev Notes by email

You no longer have to keep checking the website for updates. A small pop-up and a box on the Dev Notes page let you subscribe with your email. You get a welcome scroll immediately, and every time I post a new dev note it lands in your inbox with a link to read it. You can unsubscribe with one click anytime.

## 6. Where to find ZUBA: 14 platforms

The Token page and home page now show 14 places where $ZUBA is live or tracked, each with its real logo: PancakeSwap, CoinGecko's GeckoTerminal, DEX Screener, DEXTools, FireScreener, Coinpaprika, PooCoin, Ave.ai, GMGN, LiveCoinWatch, Bitquery's DEXRabbit, Peniwallet, Giant Wallet and BscScan.

## 7. Allies of the Village

Our partner section now shows 14 partners in two rows that glide smoothly in opposite directions. Welcome again to Mamba Coin, Gracia Token, Catademia, Unity Makes One Token, Snow Cat, Luminous AI, IAped Token, Cat Cake Token, Phoenix Token, Kinesis Flow, Phenomenal Cat Coin, Light Speed Cat Token, uTrading and our other allies. We move together.

## 8. Answers in one place

The home page now ends with a **Questions** section: what ZUBA is, how to buy safely, the official contract address, supply, audit and KYC, what $ZUBA is used for, and how to partner with us. New members can get answers in seconds.

## 9. Our new Telegram home

Our community Telegram is now **t.me/zubatokenchat**, and every link on the website points there. Come in and say hello.

## 10. Built to be found

Behind the scenes, I worked on how search engines and social apps see us. The website is now verified on Google Search Console, has a full sitemap so Google can find every page, game, film, blog post and dev note, and tells Google who we are and where our socials live. Every page has proper titles, descriptions and preview images. The ZUBA name is now written in full everywhere across the site, and the new ZUBA runner artwork is our official preview image when anyone shares zubatoken.com.

**Why it matters:** when someone searches for ZUBA, they should find us, not a copycat.

## What this all means

ZUBA now has a home that looks, sounds and works like the universe we are building. Holders can follow progress by email, partners and talents can apply in minutes, and every story we publish can travel across the internet with one tap.

Thank you for riding with us. The Motherland has entered the game, and we are only getting started.

**Dev. Vicky**
Founder, ZUBA Token

title: ZUBA Gets a New Look
summary: New 2D art across the site, ZUBA in divine royal attire, a rebuilt token page and the first ZUBA whitepaper.
achievements: Redrew ZUBA standing in divine African royal attire, plus fire guardian, explorer and griot looks
Redid every film and game in a clean 2D African animation style
Rebuilt the token page: supply, allocation, audit and KYC, utilities and where to trade
Published the ZUBA whitepaper as an in-game storybook
Added our partners and live listings: PancakeSwap, DEX Screener and BscScan
next: Share early concept work from the first game
body:
A legend needs a face the world remembers. This update gave ZUBA a new one.

We moved the whole site to a clean 2D animation style inspired by the best of African animation, and dressed ZUBA in the gold, white and violet of a guardian of stories.

The token page now tells the coin's story in five short chapters, and the whitepaper explains why we exist, what we are building and how $ZUBA fits into it. Read it, then tell us what you think in the village.

body:
Every journey needs a camp. Today we set ours.

This notebook is where the builders of ZUBA report back to the village. No hype, no fog: what we shipped, what we learned and where we are heading next. Each entry is a marker on the map. Follow the trail and you will always know exactly where we stand.

> Ubuntu: I am because we are.

See you at the next marker.
